children: SETTLEMENT WILL TAKE PLACE ON 30 SEPTEMBER 2026, ON WHICH DATE THE CONSIDERATION OF EUR 15.60 (CUM DIVIDEND) PER TENDERED SHARE WILL BE PAID
48,981,978 SHARES TENDERED UNDER OFFER, I.E. ABOUT 89.81% OF INPOST'S ISSUED AND OUTSTANDING SHARE CAPITA
EURONEXT AMSTERDAM HAS CONDITIONALLY APPROVED THE DELISTING OF SHARES FROM EURONEXT AMSTERDAM TO TAKE PLACE ON 23 OCTOBER 2026
DELISITING CONDITIONAL ON OFFEROR HOLDING AT LEAST 95% OF SHARES FOLLOWING SETTLEMENT IN POST-ACCEPTANCE PERIOD
IF OFFEROR HOLDS LESS THAN 95%, OFFEROR AND INPOST WILL PROCURE DELISTING AS SOON AS POSSIBLE
